title: Endpoint creation — friction map & microcopy iterations
content:
Purpose:
Quick working doc to capture where people get stuck during endpoint creation + compact microcopy alternatives to test. Use this as the single-source list for the November grooming + small AB tests before launch.

Context & scope:
- Focus: Model catalog -> Endpoint quick-create -> Pin/version selection -> Finalize route
- Goal: Remove points of uncertainty that cause drop-offs or redundant support tickets (billing, version semantics, regional routing).
- Audience: Product PMs, UX, FE, SRE for rollout gating.

Observed friction (from interviews + analytics):
1) "Which model should I pick?" — engineers confused by similar model names and no quick perf/latency summary; they open docs and then abandon flow.
2) Version ambiguity — users unsure what pinning does vs ephemeral route. Leads to accidental drift when model updates land.
3) Cost surprises — lack of cost signal for chosen variant (quantized vs fp16) at selection time. Post-creation billing questions.
4) Region/latency routing — users unsure whether endpoint will run in chosen region; network/egress concerns for Private deployments.
5) Error handling on validation — cryptic errors cause users to drop into Slack/Support.
6) Naming and ownership — what to name endpoint, confusion about team ownership visibility.

Wireframe frames (sketch descriptions):
A. Quick-create compact card (left): model picker + two-line summary (latency 95th / tokens cost index) + radio for route type (stable/canary). Middle: variant pin selector (dropdown with badges: pinned, latest, recommended). Right: submit area with small cost estimate and region selector.
B. Detail expansion (accordion): perf chart sample, common prompt latency estimate, compat flags (reorder-by-price toggle).
C. Version modal: microcopy explaining "Pinning locks endpoint to a model snapshot" with quick examples: rollback workflow link and auto-fallback checkbox.
D. Empty state for model search: suggestion chips ("chat", "summarization", "embedding-optimized") and CTA: "Try recommended model".

Microcopy iterations (targeted fields):
1) Model picker primary caption (short):
  - A: "Model — recommended for chat (latency ≈40ms, cost ★★)"
  - B: "Model — Chat-optimized. 95th latency: 40ms. Cost: moderate"
  - C: "Chat-optimized — good latency for short prompts; lower throughput for long sequences"
Test: click-through to detail and drop-off rate.

2) Pin selector helper text:
  - A: "Pin to specific model version — prevents automatic updates to new weights."
  - B: "Pin locks the endpoint to this version. To receive upgrades, unpin or use a rollout."
  - C: "Pinned: stable behavior. Unpinned: auto-updates to newer versions."
Acceptance: support tickets referencing accidental upgrades drop by 60% in trial orgs.

3) Cost estimate near submit button:
  - A: "Est. cost: $0.003 / token (1k prompt): $3"
  - B: "Monthly est (1M tokens): $3,000 — toggles for more/less traffic"
  - C: small inline tooltip: "Estimate derived from model profile and your default batch settings"
Metric: reduce post-creation cost inquiries.

4) Region chooser microcopy:
  - A: "Run this endpoint in: us-west-2 — affects latency & data residency"
  - B: "Region controls where inference runs. Choose a region close to users or private infra."

5) Validation errors user-facing (short friendly tone):
  - Example: "Invalid route name: must start with a letter, 3–30 chars."
  - Replace cryptic server text with actionable text + next step button.

Friction-map quick visual mapping (textual):
- Entry: user lands on model catalog -> confusion point at model names -> probe shows users open docs and compare 3 models -> high friction.
- Mid: selecting version -> ambiguous wording causes choice of 'latest' which leads to unpredictable behavior -> high impact (production instability).
- Exit: creation success -> first-time view of endpoint lacking cost/owner metadata -> support & follow-up config changes.

Backlog (grooming-ready items):
1) Small (1): Add 2-line summary meta to model cards (latency & cost star). UX + FE. JIRA: RD-2145.
2) Medium (2): Pinning helper modal copy + sample rollback flow links. UX + Docs + SRE to document rollback.
3) Medium (2): Inline cost estimator (1k tokens sample) near submit, with tooltip. FE + Billing integration.
4) Large (3): Region-aware routing UI + private deployment KMS notice. Requires infra + privacy review.
5) Small (1): Replace server-side validation messages with friendly messages + quick fix buttons.
6) Spike (1): AB test harness for microcopy variants (1 week run).

Estimates: sizes are t-shirt (S=1, M=2, L=3). Prioritization: 1,3,5 are quick wins; 2 requires docs & SRE alignment; 4 gated by compliance.

Acceptance criteria (for v1 of flow):
- Model picker's two-line summary visible on 80% of catalog cards in quick-create.
- Pin helper modal appears on first-time pinning with clear CTA to "learn more" and links to rollback doc.
- Cost estimator shows an explicit estimate and tooltip; post-creation billing tickets reduced by 30% in pilot orgs.
- Validation errors are replaced with friendly copy and inline fix buttons where applicable.

Open questions & risks:
- Should "recommended" badge be algorithmic (usage-based) or product-curated? (ops + product decision)
- How to surface quantization impact concisely without scaring non-engineering users? (suggest: "cost tier" label + expand for details)
- Canary rollouts vs pinned versions: do we offer both on same route selector? Implementation complexity note: mixing canary with pin complicates routing table.
- Privacy/regulatory note: displaying region may leak infra topology details; confirm with legal before showing internal region names.

Quick A/B plan (two-week experiment):
- Test 1: Model caption A vs B (click-to-detail, create rate) — sample size: 100 orgs with 2-week traffic.
- Test 2: Pin helper text A vs C (support tickets referencing upgrades) — measure over 30 days.

Next steps (next 2 weeks):
- UX: finalize 3 microcopy variants for model caption + pin modal. (Owner: Aisha)
- FE: prototype two-line summary card in quick-create mock (Diego)
- Billing: stub cost estimator endpoint for sample estimates (Tom)
- SRE: draft rollback doc + identify signals for auto-fallback (Priya)
- Research: pick 2 pilot customers to test flow and gather qualitative feedback (Yuna)

Notes to reviewers:
- This is intentionally sketchy — we want quick iteration and small AB tests not a big spec. Add TODOs inline or attach screenshots to the linked PR.
- If you have objections to the copy tone (friendly, concise), propose concrete alternative lines here rather than high-level comments.

Recent change log:
- 2026-02-18: Added cost estimator variations after billing sync.
- 2026-03-10: Finalized acceptance criteria and prioritized backlog items for grooming sprint 2026-03-15.

Attachments (for later): wireframe PNGs, quick-create prototype link, AB-test plan doc.
